Tender for PACS
Wednesday, 10 December 2014
7288 Hits
Kasturba Hospital, a 972-bed teaching hospital invites bids (Two bid System) for Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of PAC from reputed organizations for a fully integrated Web based and browser independent Radiology Information System (RIS) and Picture Archival Communication System (PACS) and integrating it with the existing Hospital Information System.
The vendors should have successfully implemented RIS and PACS in at least two 500-bedded hospitals.
The tender documents can either be downloaded from the website (www.mgims.ac.in)  or collected in person on payment of Rs. 2,000/- (Rupees Two Thousand Only) by Demand Draft favouring Dean, MGIMS, Sevagram towards non-refundable tender fee from the Central Store, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, on all working days between 10.00 am and 5.00 pm from December 11, 2014. The Tender, complete in all respects, should reach Central Store at the below mentioned address latest by 3.00 pm on 31 December 2014.
The Dean reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
